snippet.title: AIR: Behind the Scenes
snippet.description:
Going behind the scenes of AIR with Ben Affleck and Matt Damon is an interesting ride! Michael Jordan himself is heavily involved in the casting and made some major requests to the production team in order for the movie to get made. The number one request was that Viola Davis plays his mother – because his mother absolutely ran things! He said he didn’t want anyone else but Viola to play her. Obviously, Viola was honored at the request, but considerably nervous because she was set to play a real, tangible, woman. She definitely didn’t take the role lightly. Another specific request made by Michael Jordan was that his father be cast in the light of his personality – he said his father had the best personality ever and he really wanted that to shine through. Ben Affleck said he knew the perfect man for it – who happens to be Viola Davis’ husband, Julius Tennon. Apparently, he is the most hilarious guy who everyone loves to be around on set. There was also a lot of discussion about Michael Jordan’s character in the film – he’s actually nowhere to be seen! Ben Affleck said he couldn’t possibly get someone to play the iconic man without it being truly unbelievable. He said he’d rather him just be talked about and referenced a lot, rather than take the audience out of it with someone who couldn’t stand up to the iconic reputation Michael Jordan has on the world. There’s a lot to jump into here, so stick around!

snippet.title: Sci-Fi Movies That Make No Scientific Sense
snippet.description:
There are a lot of movies in science fiction that are actually impossible in real life, but that’s kind of what makes it fun to watch, am I right? Still, though, let’s dive a little bit deeper and really get into the facts that these films are spewing in their narrative. There are a lot of things in Jurassic Park that could never happen, but for one, where did they get that one hundred million-year-old dinosaur DNA? Where does one even begin to look for something like that? In The Day After Tomorrow, their depiction at which the speed of climate change happened was completely insane. The fact that helicopters froze in mid-air was more than just a little unlikely. In I Am Legend there were a lot of things that could never happen – one of those being the way the virus just decided to switch it up on us – viruses don’t do stuff like that. The real King Kong – at that size, would actually be a lot bulkier and move a lot slower than depicted in the movie. He wouldn’t be able to stay the same proportions and hold up his body weight. Inception has a lot going on and to be fair, Christopher Nolan did get a lot of things right about dreams, but just the fact that they were willy-nilly inserting themselves into people’s brainwaves is a hard no – that’s just factually impossible. I’ll be going into those movies and quite a few others – let’s debunk Hollywood.

snippet.title: 90s Movies That Would Never Get Made Today
snippet.description:
Let’s be real – we love to put on a 90s movie for a nice dose of nostalgia, but if you really look at a good portion of them, a lot of them should be canceled. We’ve got some serious teacher student creepiness in Never Been Kissed, American Pie’s webcam scene is ultimately evil and cringe, American Beauty is a lawsuit waiting to happen, and Ace Ventura: Pet Detective is incredibly transphobic. I still love the 90s, but it really makes me cringe when I think about how awful some of the narratives were. Cruel Intentions was one of my favorite movies, but there are some really questionable scenes involving SA and manipulation that are really hard to overlook – as much as I will always love Sarah Michelle Gellar, the movie is problematic. Forrest Gump is iconic, but Tom Hanks’ performance of a ‘slow-witted’ man – which won an Oscar – would never fly today. Did you know Aladdin had an incredibly offensive lyric that Disney scrambled to change before the home video release? And as much as I love Lana Del Rey, she’ll never get me to like Lolita – it’s way too creepy. The fact that it got not only one, but two movies based on the book is beyond me. Unfortunately, there is a lot to unpack in this list of 90s movies – don’t come for me when I ruin some of your favorites, but make sure to stick around until the very end of the video. Which 90s movies do you think should have been included in the list?

snippet.title: The Last of Us Without VFX
snippet.description:
The VFX in HBO series The Last of Us is so incredibly smooth, you would have no idea exactly what’s a blue screen and what’s real cityscape! In the scene where Bella Ramsey and Pedro Pascal are in the Firefly hospital wing staring out at the ‘view,’ that’s actually just a blue screen! They had me totally convinced that I was looking off at this stellar view of the city. Nope – just great acting. The practical effects are completely out of this world. The clickers are actually just real actors underneath a massive layer of prosthetics. Barrie Gower – who has worked on major projects like Stranger Things – helped design the prosthetics for the infected. The bloater was also eighty pounds of prosthetic and latex foam! It was topped off with a bit of CGI in post-production, but what you’re looking at on the screen is basically what they’re looking at on the set. The visual effects crew did a ton of research beforehand – especially when it came to the environment. They traveled to all of the different cities they used – like Boston – for the QZ shots. They took tons of photos so they were able to digitally recreate them for the show. A ton of what we’re looking at when it comes to the city was completely blue screen! There’s a lot to unpack here, so make sure you stick around until the end of the video! What’s your favorite visual effects moment in The Last of us?

snippet.title: Harry Potter actors who hated working on set
snippet.description:
If you’re a fan of the Harry Potter movies - and who isn’t? - then you’re probably familiar with the gang of excellent actors who made these movies come alive. (With help, of course, from a TON of amazing CGI effects.) And considering the main cast got to not only be a part of a historical series of movies, but also got to become rich and famous in the process, you’d think that they would all have nothing but positive things to say about the experience. But, sadly, you’d be wrong. It turns out that there are a lot of actors and actresses from the Harry Potter movies who have serious issues with it. Some have issues with the series as a whole, and the general process of making them. Others had issues with the fact that they had to learn how to act in front of the cameras. And many of them had issues with particular scenes, or elements of filming. All in all, it’s a pretty wild tale of these uber famous actors who ultimately were disappointed by a lot of the movies that made them stars. But it also goes to show that every job, no matter how glamorous, can have serious downsides. And especially for young kids, or people who are introverted by nature, the pressures and realities of fame can be really hard to deal with. snippet.title: John Wick Without VFX

We’re gonna take you on the wildest John Wick VFX ride filled with insane motorcycle crashes, Keanu Reeves learning how to drift cars behind the scenes with no CGI involved! There’s definitely your fair share of CGI moments in John Wick, but I was pleased to find out that a fair amount of it is good old practical stunt work. Pretty intense! They’ve got Jackson Spidell doing falls from major heights and actually slamming to the ground more realistically than he would’ve liked. He actually had the crew on set pretty worried about his well-being after that. There’s also the intense motorcycle fight that was inspired by a scene in the action film “The Villainess.” Director, Chad Stahelski and Keanu Reeves both loved the action element of that scene, so they wanted to try and recreate it for John Wick. It proved to be a lot more difficult than anyone on set could have imagined that day. Stunt performer Joe Dryden also had his work cut out for him sliding down the middle of the road with a motorcycle nine times. He said that chase scene was one of the most difficult performances he’s ever done in his entire career. The vibes behind the scenes of this film franchise will have you floored with how much hard work, creativity, incredible stunt work, and long hours of training goes into it. snippet.title: John Wick 4: Behind the Scenes
snippet.description:
We’re gonna be taking a deep dive into everything John Wick! John Wick 4 is packed with incredible action, adventure, and stunt-work performed by Keanu Reeves. As John Wick fans know, Keanu Reeves is very set on doing as many stunts as he possibly can – this leads to some intense training. He honed his driving skills for nine months before shooting even started just so he could perform the major car chase scene – they refer to it as Car-Fu behind the scenes. There’s a scene where Keanu has to perform a 180 drift, reload his prop gun, and shoot it out the door. That was definitely the most difficult driving scene for him to master, but at this point, Keanu Reeves is now considered a professional stunt driver. When it came to his training, he didn’t mess around. He was always the first one at the gym or on set ready to learn a new skill and always the last to leave. There were also a couple of major injuries on set, but surprisingly, only a couple. One guy actually got hit by a car and had to be taken to the hospital – luckily, he was okay, but it just goes to show you how dangerous this caliber of stunt work is, even if you’re not the one performing it. I’ve got a lot to unpack here about John Wick 4, so make sure you stick around for the entire video like Keanu Reeves would!

snippet.title: John Wick stunts Behind the Scenes
snippet.description:
The John Wick franchise may be the very best action franchise out there today. It is a true work of art in the action movie genre. The story of master assassin John Wick getting back into the complex world of suited assassins around the world is one of the most epic stories playing out on the screen today. Most of this comes down to the incredible action sequences that are much faster and more tightly choreographed than anything you might see in other films. It’s a true masterclass in how to do action right. So how do these legendary stunts work?

For starters, it requires a ton of preparation. You would not believe how much time is taken to make sure all of the action scenes are properly choreographed before the actors spend months training to make the scenes look as realistic as possible. Of course, it’s not all real. Many of the sequences feature CGI that’s so great you probably never realized that what you were looking at wasn’t real. 

The best special effect is without a doubt Keanu Reeves. He is the secret ingredient that makes the entire series work. His level of skill is so great that it’s hard to see how the series would even exist without him. Though there are times when even he gets replaced by a stunt performer. What could be so dangerous that even Keanu Reeves wouldn’t do it? It has to be very scary indeed to keep Keanu away.

So how do those John Wick fight scenes come out so well? Only one way to find out!

snippet.title: Scenes in TV Series Banned in Other Countries

Some TV shows are international hits, and their messages, plotlines, and even jokes carry across many cultures. And if a show can appeal to people all over the world, it’s another great way for it to generate money… aka stay on the air for a lot longer. And that makes fans of those shows quite happy. However, there are times that certain scenes and episodes don’t match up with the cultural and political morals of a certain country or region. But instead of refusing to air these shows completely, they will often just ban a particular episode, or even a scene within an episode. Of course, that process isn’t unique to cultures abroad. Episodes and scenes sometimes get banned within the US airwaves for a variety of reasons. Sometimes it’s because they deal with sensitive political or cultural topics. Other times its because they are deemed not to be appropriate for the potential younger audiences that might see them. In this video, we’re taking a look at some shows that have had episodes or scenes banned in various parts of the world. Then we also take a look at several shows that have had episodes pulled from streamers and networks globally or in the U.S. These shows vary from science fiction hits, to kids shows, to classic sitcoms, to current hits. And the reasons for the banning are pretty all over the place. So check out this video today, as we take a look at scenes and episodes of TV series that have been banned!

snippet.title: Everything Everywhere All At Once Facts
snippet.description:
Did you know that Jackie Chan was originally considered to play the lead role in Everything Everywhere All At Once? That’s right, here’s everything you’ve always wanted to know about one of the most original movies ever made. Directed by Daniel Scheinert and Daniel Kwan (aka “The Daniels”) this movie had a super low budget to deliver pure cinematic awesomeness. They only had 14 million dollars to make all their movie magic dreams come true! So they had to get pretty creative with practical effects, and visual effects. Also, there’s a ton of star power behind this movie. Michelle Yeoh did an outstanding job as the lead. But did you know that Daniel Radcliffe was supposed to have a small cameo? Aaron Lazar ended up taking his role, you might remember him from Wolf Of Wall Street and Avengers Endgame. This film only had a crew of five people for all their special effects, including CGI and practical effects. They ended up improvising a lot, and finding cheap alternatives to expensive CGI set ups. Also, those hot dog hands were real gloves made by the practical effects team! And that raccoon was a real puppet–so convincing! If you ever wanted to know why so much of the movie takes place in a laundromat, don’t worry, we’ll tell you, but you have to watch the video to find out why!

snippet.title: 15 Times Heroes Became Villains
snippet.description:
A hero is supposed to stand true in the face of hardship. But what happens when they just can’t anymore? These fifteen movie heroes managed to fall far enough to become the villains. Walter White from the AMC series Breaking Bad is a classic example, alongside Anakin Skywalker who became Darth Vader in the Star Wars franchise. Scarlet Witch from the Marvel Cinematic Universe has had an interesting moral arc so far, starting out as a hero who fought alongside the Avengers before moving on to force an entire town to play out her sitcom fantasy in WandaVision, and then becoming a full-on villain in Doctor Strange and the Multiverse of Madness. Light Yagami serves as simultaneous hero and villain in Death Note, to the point that the term anti-hero may be more apt. Scrappy Doo started out as a hero in the Scooby Doo universe, although James Gunn had different ideas when he wrote him into Scooby Doo: The Movie. Daenerys Targaryen became a bit of a surprise villain in the final seasons of the HBO series Game of Thrones. Harvey Dent was supposed to prove the hero that Batman couldn’t be, but the Dark Knight shows us that Gotham City may just be beyond help. Saruman the White was meant to protect the people of Middle Earth in the Lord of the Rings, but the lure of the One Ring was just too strong for him to deny. Jean Grey betrayed the X-Men when she turned herself into Dark Phoenix, just as Lex Luther betrayed Superman on the WB series Smallville.

snippet.title: 15 Times Villains Became Heroes
snippet.description:
Not all bad guys are bad. These movie villains still try to do the right thing, and some even become heroes. This list explores a few of our favorite examples, starting out with Loki from the Marvel Cinematic Universe. His relationship with Thor has been a changing one throughout the franchise, starting out as antagonists in Thor and the Avengers before the two of them grew closer in Thor: Ragnarok and Avengers: Infinity War. Darth Vader from the Star Wars franchise struggled with his pull toward both the light and dark sides of the Force, which became a bit of an influence on his grandson Kylo Ren in the sequel trilogy. Severus Snape from the Harry Potter franchise was a difficult one to figure out until we reached the end in Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows Part 2. Harley Quinn of the DC Extended Universe had a bit of a difficult relationship with the Joker, but her work alongside the Suicide Squad and the Birds of Prey proves that she’s capable of so much more. Hector Barbossa from The Walt Disney Company’s Pirates of the Caribbean franchise may have marooned Jack Sparrow, but his relationship with his daughter suggests that he’s a much nicer pirate than we could have expected. Arnold Schwarzenegger inspired the T-800 in the Terminator movies to become reprogrammed. Meanwhile, Apollo Creed’s relationship with Rocky inspired the events of the following Creed movies starring Michael B. Jordan. Deckard Shaw of the Fast & Furious movie franchise showed us that there’s no lengths he isn’t willing to go to for family.

Tim Burton had a few unique ideas when it came to building the world of the Addams family, including asking Jenna Ortega not to blink, and hiring Victor Dorobantu to play Thing! snippet.title: Actors Who Took a Role Written For Others
snippet.description:
Sometimes we watch a performance by an actor and think, “Wow, that role must have been written FOR them!” And sure, often that’s true. Especially when it comes to A-listers, writers and directors will come up with roles that are specifically written for someone. Or at least, with that actor in mind. And then, if the actor is unavailable, they have to figure out plan B. But there have also been some absolutely classic performances by actors, where you’d assume the part was written specifically for them… but the opposite is true. The role was actually written specifically for another person! It happens more than you’d think. It’s especially surprising when their performance is so spot on that it’s hard to imagine anyone else playing the role. But since landing the ideal actor for a role isn’t always the easiest thing to do, other actors are often brought in to replace the actor the role was created for. In this video, we’re taking a look at some big time roles performed by big time actors. But the twist is that none of these roles were written for those specific actors. They were developed with a different A-list actor in mind. And then, for a variety of reasons, the first actor became unavailable. We’ll go over some pretty wild actor and actress combinations, with names like Tom Cruise, Tom Hanks, Idris Elba, Will Smith, Michelle Yeoh, Jackie Chan, and more. It’s a fun exploration it what could have been with some pretty big movies! So check out this video today, as we explore some roles that were actually written for another big star than the one who ended up getting the gig.

snippet.title: Cocaine Bear: Movie vs Real Life
snippet.description:
Cocaine Bear is perhaps the craziest film to come out in 2023 so far. It is a wild story involving a huge shipment of drugs that were thrown out into the wilderness and then found by an innocent bear who then goes on a rampage of kooky behavior and murderous activities. It’s a wild and brutal film that features several of the best young actors working in Hollywood today. It’s also a horrifying look at what can happen if you take nature for granted. Bears are terrifying whether they’re on cocaine or not. It turns out that this was based on a real story, though the real story features a lot less of the bear eating people unfortunately.

This was an instant legend of a story where a bear went to town on a big pile of cocaine and then passed away from it. The bear was then stuffed and made into an American folk antihero. One that has been a giant legend for several decades. He’s even featured in a mall in all of his stuffed glory. A true monument to American magnificence. 

It’s also a huge turn for Elizabeth Banks. Her career has not been anything like this until now. Funnily enough, her attraction to this project wasn’t because of how ridiculous it was but how it helped her process the last few years of chaos. It will make you love her more.

So what’s the deal with the real Cocaine Bear? Only one way to find out right now!

snippet.title: Creed: How Michael B Jordan Trained For Adonis
snippet.description:
I really wanted to know everything Michael B. Jordan went through when filming Creed III! The Creed franchise is no joke – he and Jonathan Majors, as well as the rest of the cast, took place in what they called a “Creed Camp Boxing Training” run by Mark Rhino Smith. The camp was intense! They wanted every actor who was going to be setting foot in the boxing ring to look like they were true professionals. Part of looking like a professional boxer is getting the footwork right – that took the longest out of every aspect of the training. Michael B. Jordan was working out six days a week on top of boxing camp! His personal trainer, and long-time friend, Corey Calliet, didn’t want to burn him out, so he would work out in short, but intense spurts throughout the day – oftentimes up to four times a day! Michael was also basically living off of turkey and rice! The guy was literally eating turkey for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Can you imagine?! There was one day of the week when he was allowed to eat pretty much whatever he wanted, so he would often opt for a burger or something – which would actually make his muscles pop! Go figure! Corey Calliet does not advise any sort of diet or restriction in order to achieve your goals – he just advises you to keep up your training! If you want to know more about what Michael B. Jordan went through, make sure you stick around until the end of the video!

snippet.title: The Mandalorian: Behind the Scenes
snippet.description:
We’re going behind the scenes of Disney’s The Mandalorian – the well acclaimed Star Wars series. We’re going to be digging into everything that makes Grogu so incredible – did you know that it takes four puppeteers to operate the little guy? Also, we get to share a cute moment with Pedro Pascal in the sound booth replacing baby Yoda with a hilarious prop of choice. There is so much that goes into the visual effects of The Mandalorian that it’s hard to put into just one video! For one thing, the technology they used is relatively new and incredibly innovative! They are easily putting the use of green screens to shame and creating an entire stage that’s wrapped in LED screens. The set that we see when we’re watching the show at home on TV is the exact same set that the actors were performing in. How wild is that? They would often forget that they’re not actually outside or on this strange planet, that they’re just inside a sound stage. They can also change the set in the blink of an eye and everything is backed up so it’s super easy to go right back to where they were. This show took everything into account – even giving Pedro Pascal two stunt doubles! That’s actually not commonplace in Hollywood – typically there’s only one stunt double for an actor, but obviously we have to protect Pedro Pascal at all costs! Make sure to stick around until the end of the video to find out all of Disney’s technological secrets!

snippet.title: Paul Rudd Facts That Make Us Love Him Even More
snippet.description:
Everyone loves Paul Rudd. He’s an amazing actor and seems to be an amazing person in real life. Of course, everyone knows that just because a person seems like they’re really cool, doesn’t mean that they are actually cool in real life. The internet is flooded with stories about how actors are actually horrible people in real life. Waiters, co-stars, and random people in the world have seen these actors out in the world and have reported the times in which they’ve screamed at people, acted like they were better than normal people, or just generally acted rude. So if Paul Rudd actually nice or is he another jerk?

Turns out that he’s even nicer than people thought he was! The internet is full of stories about how Paul Rudd has been incredibly kind while shooting movies and in real life. Evidently sometimes it can be hard to film certain movies because they are way too funny to keep a straight face. Other times the cast is just having too much fun and can’t contain themselves.

Then there are the times he’s been spotted out in the world. Rudd has a great track record when it comes to having great interactions with fans, bullied kids, and candy shops. You won’t believe which Walking Dead star is one of his closest friends.

Not only that but he’s also a terrific Dad. Though he doesn’t understand what’s required of him for a perfect Marvel Halloween.

So what is Paul Rudd like in real life? Only one way to find out!

snippet.title: Sorting Disney Characters Into Harry Potter Houses
snippet.description:
What Hogwarts House do your Disney favorites belong in? Today, we’ll be taking a look at ten animated Disney characters and trying to decide, do they belong in Gryffindor, Slytherin, Hufflepuff, or Ravenclaw? And what might their life even look like if they had the chance to study alongside Harry Potter, Ronald Weasley, and Hermione Granger? The sisters from Frozen are sorted into houses that may actually surprise you. Ariel from The Little Mermaid is set to receive a live action remake starring Halle Bailey, but here we’re imagining how much she’d love Muggle Studies while studying at Hogwarts. Belle from Beauty and the Beast shows a surprising amount of similarities to Hermione, which may just go to show that there was a reason Emma Watson was chosen for the role in her live action remake. Several of the Disney princesses would probably do well playing Quidditch, between Jasmine from Aladdin playing as either a Chaser or Keeper, while Rapunzel from Tangled would definitely have to play a Beater! Have you seen her swing that frying pan? Rapunzel would also probably excel at Care of Magical Creatures and get along great with Newt Scamander of the Fantastic Beasts franchise. Merida from Brave is the only character on this list who’s been brought over from Pixar, but we can see that she’d share a lot of similarities to the Boy Who Lived, although we can’t imagine Daniel Radcliffe with quite so much hair! Tiana from the Princess and the Frog would have a great time while in Potions class, but maybe not so much during Transfigurations.

snippet.title: Rihanna's Superbowl Halftime Show: Behind the Scenes
snippet.description:
By now you’ve definitely seen the Rihanna Super Bowl Halftime show! Well, if you haven’t, don’t worry, we’ve got all the juicy behind the scenes details to catch you up! Did you know that Rihanna is the first woman to ever perform at the super bowl while pregnant? While she and husband A$AP Rocky like to keep their kids out of the limelight, Rihanna has officially confirmed it’s true, she’s having another baby! Her baby bump could be seen in her custom-made costume designed by the creative director of Loewe, Jonathan Anderson. He wasn’t the only famous artist to have a hand in the performance. Adam Blackstone, of previous halftime show fame, co-directed the Rihanna show along with legendary choreographer Parris Goebel. And what about all those moving platforms on stage? Don’t worry, they’re strong enough to support a freight train. Riahnna could fly high above the field like a diamond in the sky, while still looking amazing and being totally safe. Yes, Rihanna was the only celebrity on stage that night—that’s right, no guest appearances! But did she really need them? Even though many famous musicians have featured in her music (Drake, Jay Z, Eminem), Adam Blackstone and Rihanna decided it would be best for her to appear completely solo, because let's face it, this is her moment. Does she even need anyone else on those platforms with her? If you’re curious about Rihanna’s crazy rehearsal schedule, be sure to watch until the end of the video! One thing is certain though, Rihanna is a Queen.

snippet.title: Pamela: A Love Story Behind the Scenes
snippet.description:
There have been a string of documentaries aimed at young women of the 90s and early 2000s who are now taking command of their own narratives. This has been a great trend that has really empowered a beleaguered generation of stars who now have a chance to set the record straight about who they really are. Pamela Anderson is the latest person to grab the spotlight and shine it where she wants it. A life of modeling, Baywatch, and Home Improvement were all ruined by the unethical way a tape of her and Tommy Lee was released to the public. It ruined her life and now she’s grabbing it back. That being said, this triumphant moment couldn’t have been easy for her. She goes into some of the greatest traumas of her life and holds nothing back.

Well, getting to know Pamela, it’s clear that this is just the way she lives her life. She has an incredible relationship with her sons, one of whom produced the film, and was able to put her past and the Hulu series Pam & Tommy behind her. So what was it like to make this series? What was it like to go to the premiere with her sons? How did the legendary indie documentary director score this job? And how does Tommy Lee feel about it? All of these questions are answered and more as we look into the incredible life of Pamela Anderson and the triumphant way she’s taken control of her own narrative.

So what was this doc like behind the scenes? There’s only one way to find out right now!
